description: Java entity class representing a download record associated with an order product, including metadata such as filename, download limits, and count.

classes.name: OrderProductDownload
classes.description: Entity class for representing downloadable products associated with a specific order, including filename, max days to download, and download count.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the download record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the download record.

methods.name: getOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the download.

methods.name: setOrderProductFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename for the download.

methods.name: getMaxdays
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed days to download.

methods.name: setMaxdays
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed days to download.
